name: hk-dpo-als_01-als
title: Address Lookup Service
notes:
1.Address Lookup Service (ALS) is a web service providing lookup function on Hong Kong address records in both Chinese and English aggregated from various Government Bureaux/Departments. This web service allows data consumers to look up address records in machine-readable format (XML or JSON) using address element information. It aims to facilitate development of applications with the need to capture Hong Kong address information more efficiently and accurately.

 2.The ALS provides formatted addresses of the premises in Hong Kong, including private and public housing estates, commercial and industrial buildings, government buildings and offices, markets and shopping centers; and common facilities such as recreation and sports centres. Some addresses provided are representing a complex of buildings, such as schools or universities. Most of the addresses in ALS are available in 2-Dimensional format which typically includes up to street name, building number and building name. 3-Dimensional formatted addresses, such as addresses include flat number and floor number, they are only available for public housing estates. For more details, please refer the Data Dictionary.

 3.This service also includes unofficial descriptions of buildings which are long established addresses in rural areas of the New Territories and are generally accepted by the public.

 4.The choice of name for a building is a matter for the owner, and at present there is no controlling legislation. The inclusion of a building name in this service confers no proprietary right to it or any part of it.

 5.As there are no regulations requiring owners or developers to report or register building names, the ALS is not exhaustive. The accuracy and timeliness of its contents cannot be guaranteed. Particularly for some new buildings, the confirmation of address particulars involves business processes and coordination of multiple departments, such as surveying, reviewing data, and assigning geographical addresses, etc., which can take time to complete. Nonetheless, every effort has been made to include all known names and to check the correctness of entries. We welcome notifications from any source of new names, changes in existing names, the discontinuation of the use of names, and any omissions or errors in this service. Please contact us via email at [adi@digitalpolicy.gov.hk](mailto:adi@digitalpolicy.gov.hk). 

 6.The ALS enables data consumers to quickly retrieve full formatted address records by inputting basic address elements. Recommended input formats include 
 (a) building name, for example, “MONGKOK GOVERNMENT OFFICES”, “LAI CHI KOK GOVERNMENT OFFICES”, or 
 (b) street name and number, for example, “30 LUEN WAN STREET”, “19 LAI WAN ROAD”, or 
 (c) estate name and building block number, for example, “25 PARK ROAD GOVERNMENT QUARTERS BLOCK A”, “TSING CHUNG KOON ROAD GOVERNMENT QUARTERS BLOCK F”, or 
 (d) It is recommended to adopt the Hongkong Post’s Mailing Address Format, in the order of: unit, floor, building name, street number, street name, district, and region (Hong Kong / Kowloon / New Territories) (e.g. 100 Cyberport Road Pokfulam Hong Kong).
  Following the above search input format helps improve the search accuracy.

 7.Why is the search accuracy slightly lower when using the ALS? 
 (a) If entering “Hong Kong Special Administrative Region”: Since the ALS provides search for addresses located within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region only, there is no need to additionally input “Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.”; 
 (b) If entering non-address information (for example: elderly homes, kindergartens, hotels, or other institution details, etc.): The ALS does not provide search functions for non-address information.
  Any such extra input as illustrated above will affect the search results.

tc.title: 地址搜尋服務
tc.notes:
1.「地址搜尋服務」為網上服務，提供搜尋功能以檢索政府各決策局／部門所匯集的中、英文香港地址記錄，讓數據用戶可利用地址元資料，搜尋數碼格式(XML或JSON)的地址記錄。本網上服務旨在方便各界人士開發需要更快捷準確獲取香港地址資料的應用程式。

 2.「地址搜尋服務」提供香港處所的格式化地址，包括私人屋苑和公共房屋、商業和工業大廈、政府建築物和辦公室、市場和購物中心、以及康樂和體育中心等公共設施。此外，部份提供的處所地址亦會代表一組建築群，例如學校或大學。「地址搜尋服務」的大部份地址只提供二維格式，該類地址通常包括街道名稱、門牌號數及樓宇名稱。三維格式地址，例如包含單位號碼和樓層號碼的地址，只適用於公共房屋樓宇。詳細資料請參考「地址搜尋服務」的數據字典。

 3.本服務亦載錄一些非正式的樓宇名稱，包括新界鄉村地區內沿用已久及為人接受的地址。

 4.業主可自行選擇樓宇的名稱，現時並無法例加以管制。本服務收錄某一樓宇名稱，並不表示該樓宇獲得該名稱或其組成部分的專用權。

 5.由於現時並無法例規定業主或發展商須將樓宇名稱呈報或登記，所以本服務並未盡錄所有樓宇名稱，亦不能保證所載內容正確無誤及其時效性。尤其一些新落成樓宇，要確認其地址細節須經過多個部門的業務流程及協調，例如測量、審核資料及編配地理地址等，過程或需時間。不過，我們已竭力收錄所有已知的樓宇名稱，並加以核對，力求準確。如有新樓宇名稱，或現有樓宇名稱有所更改或停止使用，或本服務有任何錯漏之處，歡迎各界人士告知和指正，聯絡電郵：[adi@digitalpolicy.gov.hk](mailto:adi@digitalpolicy.gov.hk)。 

 6.地址搜尋服務能讓數據用戶透過輸入簡單的地址元資料，快速搜尋出完整的格式化地址記錄。建議輸入的地址元資料格式包括： 
 (甲) 樓宇名稱，例如：「旺角政府合署」、「荔枝角政府合署」；或 
 (乙) 街道名稱及門牌號碼，例如：「聯運街30號」、「荔灣道19號」；或 
 (丙) 屋邨名稱及樓宇座數，例如：「栢道25號政府宿舍A座」、「青松觀道政府宿舍F座」；或 
 (丁) 建議採用香港郵政的郵寄地址格式，其順序為：區域（香港/九龍/新界）、地區、街道名稱、 街道號碼、大廈名稱、樓層、單位(例如：香港薄扶林數碼港道100號)等。 
 遵循上述格式有助提升搜尋結果的準確性。

 7.為何在使用 「地址搜尋服務」進行搜尋時準確度略低？ 
 (甲) 若輸入「香港特別行政區」：由於「地址搜尋服務」僅能搜尋位於香港特別行政區的地址，因此無需額外輸入「香港特別行政區」； 
 (乙) 若輸入非地址資訊(例如：安老院、幼兒園、旅館等機構資訊) ：「地址搜尋服務」未能提供非地址資訊的搜尋； 
 上述額外輸入的資訊，均會影響搜尋結果。

name: hk-dpo-fundraise-approved-fund-raising-activities
title: Approved fund-raising activities
notes:
Information of approved fund-raising activities for Public Subscription Permit, Temporary Hawker Licence, Lottery Licence and Non-Charitable Fund-Raising Permit.

HTTP method: GET

**Parameters**:

- fromdate: First date in a date range of the fund-raising activities searching for (in yyyymmdd format).

- todate: Last date in a date range of the fund-raising activities searching for (in yyyymmdd format).

- activity: Type of activity.
  Valid values are:
  fund: General Charitable Fund-Raising Activity;
  flag: Flag Day;
  lotpub: Lottery (Obtained Approval For Selling On Public Streets);
  lotpri: Lottery (Not Obtained Approval For Selling On Public Streets);
  sell: On-street Selling For Fund-Raising Purpose;
  noncharitable: Non-Charitable Fund-Raising Activity.

- licence: Type of licence.
  Valid values are: 
  lottery: Lottery Licence;
  psp: Public Subscription Permit;
  hawker: Temporary Hawker Licence;
  noncharitable: Public Fund-raising Permit for Non-charitable Purposes.

- charitable: Charitable or non-charitable activity. 
  1 returns charitable activities; 0 returns non-charitable activities.

- orderby: Sorting order of the returned data  
  Valid values are:
  date: by activity date;
  activity: by activity type;
  licence: by licence type.

- orderstyle: Sorting order of the returned data.
  Valid values are:
  asc: ascending;
  desc: descending.

- itemperpage: no. of items returned on a page (max. 100)

- page: based on itemperpage value, the page to be returned

Note:

- If either fromdate or todate value is not provided, today's activity will be returned
- If no activity type value is specified, all records with any activity type will be returned
- If no licence type value is specified, all records with any licence type will be returned
- If no charitable value is specified, both charitable and non-charitable actvities will be returned
- If no orderby value is specified, the returned data will be sorted by date
- If no orderstyle value is specified, the returned data will be sorted by descending order
- If no itemperpage value is specified, the number of returned items will be defaulted to 10
- If itemperpage is more than 100, a maximum of 100 records will be returned for each request
- If no page value is specified, the data belongs to the first page will be returned
- Activity schedule with timeFrom 00:00 and timeTo 00:00 indicates a whole day event

resources.name: Approved fund-raising activities API (JSON)
Approved fund-raising activities API (XML)

tc.title: 獲批准的籌款活動
tc.notes:
獲批公開籌款許可證、臨時小販牌照、獎劵活動牌照或非慈善性質籌款許可證的籌款活動資料。

HTTP請求方法: GET

**參數**:

- fromdate: 籌款活動日期搜尋範圍的第一日 (yyyymmdd 格式)

- todate: 籌款活動日期搜尋範圍的最後一日(yyyymmdd 格式).

- activity: 活動類別.
  有效數值為:
  fund: 一般慈善籌款活動;
  flag: 賣旗日;
  lotpub: 獎劵活動(獲批准於公共街道售賣獎劵);
  lotpri: 獎劵活動 (沒有獲准於公共街道售賣獎劵);
  sell: 與籌款活動有關的街頭販賣活動;
  noncharitable: 非慈善性質籌款活動

- licence: 牌照類別. 
  有效數值為:
  lottery: 獎券活動牌照; 
  psp: 公開籌款許可證;
  hawker: 臨時小販牌照;
  noncharitable:非慈善性質籌款許可證

- charitable: 慈善或非慈善籌款活動。 1:慈善籌款活動; 0:非慈善籌款活動

- orderby: 傳回的資料依何排序.
  有效數值為:
  date: 按活動日期;
  activity: 按活動類別;
  licence: 按牌照類別

- orderstyle: 傳回的資料如何排序.
  有效數值為:
  asc: 從小到大排序;
  desc: 從大到小排序

- itemperpage: 供分頁之用，每次請求傳回的紀錄數量(最多為100)
- page: 供分頁之用，指定傳回資料的分頁序號(按itemperpage值分頁)

注意事項:

- 若沒有提供fromdate或todate數值，則會傳回當日之活動

- 若沒有提供activity數值，所有活動類別的紀錄都會傳回

- 若沒有提供licence數值，所有牌照類別的紀錄都會傳回

-  若沒有提供charitable數值，所有慈善與非慈善類別的紀錄都會傳回

- 若沒有提供orderby數值，傳回的資料將以日期排序

- 若沒有提供orderstyle數值，傳回的資料將從大到小排序

- 若沒有提供itemperpage數值，將會傳回10個紀錄

- 若itemperpage數值大於100，每次請求只會傳回100個紀錄

- 若沒有提供page數值，則會傳回第一頁的資料

- 若活動時間中timeFrom及timeTo均為00:00，則表示這是一個全日的活動

name: hk-hhb-hhbvhis-vhis-standard-premium
title: Standard Premiums of the Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme Certified Plans
notes: The Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme ("VHIS") is a policy initiative implemented by the Health Bureau to regulate the indemnity hospital insurance plans ("IHIP") offered to individuals.  A "Certified Plan" shall mean an individual IHIP certified by the Health Bureau as VHIS compliant, including two categories, namely the Standard Plan and Flexi Plans. 　"Standard Premium" shall mean the basic premium for the coverage under a Certified Plan, as charged by the insurance company on an overall portfolio basis, which may be adjusted in accordance with the age, gender and/or lifestyle factors of the insured person.

resources.name: Standard Premiums of the Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme Certified Plans

tc.title: 自願醫保計劃認可產品的標準保費
tc.notes: 自願醫保計劃（簡稱「自願醫保」）是醫務衞生局就規範個人償款住院保險產品推行的一項政策措施。「認可產品」是指獲醫務衞生局認可符合自願醫保下規定的個人償款住院保險產品，包括標準計劃及靈活計劃兩個類別。「標準保費」則是指保險公司就認可產品向所有同一類別保單收取的基本保費，可按受保人的年齡、性別及/或生活方式等因素進行調整。
